scope: Read-only process/port/health inventory. No service, model, Unity or feature request started or stopped.
limits: Health is an instantaneous observation and must be rechecked immediately before a model request.
Shared-model identity uses existing service provenance and the known remote feature executable; this inventory does not rerun numeric feature equivalence.
The feature POST route has no dedicated /neeeva/motion-features/health GET endpoint.
Current request-stat systemChars excludes transient motion context; it cannot establish which runtime contract was transmitted.
